verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says it breaks big projects and ideas into actionable tasks, which covers the decomposition half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents subtasks as a distinct issue type, dependency or issue links, or 'blocks / is blocked by' ordering. missing for 10: documented subtask hierarchy, dependency/blocking issue links, visualization of blocking order, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: break down big projects into clear tasks
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks
